name: Apollo
tagline: Apollo.io is an all-in-one B2B sales intelligence and engagement platform with a database of over 275 million contacts. It combines prospecting, email sequencing, calling, and CRM enrichment so sales reps can build pipeline without switching tools. AI features suggest the best-fit prospects, personalise outreach, and surface timing signals like job changes and funding rounds.
